verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the image-spelling quality rule and requires every added image to be checked for correct spelling.
The client assigns image-spelling checks to the image-generation workflow and explicitly excludes them from proofreading.
The client requires individual pre-insertion review and regeneration of misspelled images for the Ontario book; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer directly confirms that the Ontario book images were checked, without supplying independent runtime verification.
